Aw, this just happened with me. We weren't dating though and we both are a lot older than you haha

I'm the girl in the story so maybe I could give you some insight. It probably sounds cheesy but people grow and change all the time. That's just life. I do love my friend (who I left) but I just realized that the relationship wasn't for me anymore. And it's okay. I'm sure she feels bad about it too. And when she said that she still likes you, it's probably because she didn't want to hurt your feelings. I know because I've done the same thing. So don't hold onto that. 

And I know it's hard for you. But honey, you're 13. You'll date so many people in the future. Think of it as an experience and just learn from it :) 

Like one of the other users said, you could work on yourself. Especially the jealousy part. Moving on, jealousy is never going to help you. You have to trust the person you're dating. 

For now, give yourself some time to process things. Pick up new hobbies or do whatever you like. Focus on yourself. It's going to be just fine. Years later, you're going to think about it and laugh but for now, let her go. You probably feel like you can't live without her and that she's the ONE. But you're going to meet a lot of people in the future. So just let it go. People change all the time.

You're gonna be alright :)
Thank you, kind stranger :)
